content.json:
## WhoisFreaks Overview

Ingestion volume, feed breakdown, top TLDs, NRD recency, and threat-domain activity for the WhoisFreaks Microsoft Sentinel solution.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Records = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Type
| render timechart
content.title: Ingestion volume by feed (daily)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Records = count() by Type
| render piechart
content.title: Records by feed type

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true
  (WhoisFreaksMalware_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain)),
  (WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain)),
  (WhoisFreaksSpam_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain)),
  (WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain_name)),
  (WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain_name)),
  (WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithoutWhois_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain_name)),
  (WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithoutWhois_CL | extend Domain = tostring(domain_name))
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(Domain)
| extend TLD = tostring(extract(@"\.([^.]+)$", 1, Domain))
| where isnotempty(TLD)
| summarize Domains = dcount(Domain) by TLD
| top 15 by Domains
| render barchart
content.title: Top TLDs

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksNRDGtldWithWhois_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDCctldWithWhois_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend CreateDate = todatetime(create_date)
| where isnotnull(CreateDate)
| extend AgeDays = datetime_diff('day', now(), CreateDate)
| summarize Domains = dcount(tostring(domain_name)) by AgeBucket = case(
    AgeDays <= 1, "0-1 days",
    AgeDays <= 7, "2-7 days",
    AgeDays <= 30, "8-30 days",
    ">30 days")
| render barchart
content.title: NRD age (with WHOIS)

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend
    Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(tostring(domain), tostring(domain_name), ""))),
    ThreatType = tostring(coalesce(threat_type, "")),
    Confidence = todouble(confidence)
| where isnotempty(Domain)
| summarize Confidence = max(Confidence), ThreatType = any(ThreatType), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Domain
| top 50 by Confidence desc
| project Domain, ThreatType, Confidence, LastSeen
content.title: Top threat domains by confidence

content.query:
let ti = union isfuzzy=true WhoisFreaksMalware_CL, WhoisFreaksPhishing_CL, WhoisFreaksSpam_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", coalesce(tostring(domain), tostring(domain_name), "")))
| where isnotempty(Domain)
| summarize ThreatType = any(tostring(coalesce(threat_type, ""))) by Domain;
DnsEvents
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Domain = tolower(trim(" ", tostring(Name)))
| where isnotempty(Domain)
| summarize Hits = count(), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Domain, Computer
| join kind=inner ti on Domain
| project LastSeen, Domain, ThreatType, Computer, Hits
| order by LastSeen desc
| take 100
content.title: Threat domain matches in DnsEvents (if available)
